title: Upload 10+ character images into Seedance 2.5 to have it include all characters…
content:
Upload 10+ character images into Seedance 2.5 to have it include all characters together in a single ~30‑second video with interactions  
Use a much more detailed prompt to improve Seedance 2.5’s ability to integrate multiple character images into one coherent scene
